第十四章男主还是跑了

顾城第二天一早就拉着两个孩子去了派出所，看到只两三天没见的家人已经被折腾的没了人样。

“老二，我告诉你，这次的事要和闫家没完，你瞅瞅我的牙都被打掉了。”

顾海鼻青脸肿不说，咧开嘴还露出掉了两颗的门牙。

“是啊，还有咱妈也被打的很惨，咱家可不能被闫嫣骑到头上去。”

顾海媳妇也在一旁使把劲儿，那个贱女人凭什么让娘家人闹。

“我和她离婚了。”

三人震惊，不过很快直拍大腿叫好。

“好，真好，离了婚的女人我看她还能嫁什么好男人。”

“对了，老二，咱妈呢，啥时候出来？”

顾海习惯性依靠老娘，家里老二能挣钱，他只要哄好老娘要啥有啥。

“她要被判刑了。”

顾城不想再说，只把两个孩子推过去，转身就走。

“我近期不会在家，你们顾好自己。”

留下震惊又茫然的三大两小走人了，啥都没留就走了？

“孩子爸，咱们咋办呀？”

”什么怎么办，老二肯定去找人救咱娘了，先回家。”

顾海想哭，他不能没亲妈，想想以后没妈的日子没法活了。

一直没说话的顾灵灵目光死死盯着渐行渐远的背影，家里多个被判刑的人，二哥再不管家，那她还有未来吗？

等五口人回到红旗大队站在早已倒塌的顾家老屋时，才想起闫家干的好事。

“房子！老顾家住了几代人的房子啊。杀天刀的闫家人，不让人活了，我要报公安。”

“对，先去找大队长再去报公安。”

那天挨完打，老娘还说改天再重建，可没等建房人都进局子了。

“对了，那天闫家人拿走四百多块后铁皮盒子呢，没有钱咱得饿死。”

浩浩荡荡来到大队部，何洪先是惊讶，后是头疼。

“你们出来了。”

Chapter 14 The male protagonist still ran away

Gu Cheng took his two children to the police station early the next morning, and saw that his family, whom he had not seen for only two or three days, had been tortured beyond recognition.

"Second brother, let me tell you, this matter will never end with the Yan family. Just look at my teeth and they are all knocked out."

Gu Hai's nose was bruised and his face was swollen, and he opened his mouth to reveal two missing front teeth.

"Yes, and our mother was also beaten badly. Our family cannot let Yan Yan take advantage of her."

Gu Hai's wife was also trying her best. Why did that bitch let her family make trouble?

"I divorced her."

The three of them were shocked, but they quickly slapped their thighs and cheered.

"Okay, that's great. I'll see if a divorced woman can marry a good man."

"By the way, second brother, where is our mother, when will she come out?"

Gu Hai was accustomed to relying on his mother. The second oldest child in the family could make money, so he only had to coax her to get her whatever she wanted.

"She's going to be sentenced."

Gu Cheng didn't want to say any more, so he just pushed the two children over, turned around and left.

"I won't be home soon, please take care of yourselves."

Leaving behind the three adults and two children who were shocked and confused, they left without leaving anything behind?

"Dad, what should we do?"

"What should we do? The second child must have gone to find someone to save our mother. Let's go home first."

Gu Hai wanted to cry. He couldn't live without his biological mother. He thought about how he would not be able to live without his mother in the future.

Gu Lingling, who had been silent all this time, stared at the back of the person who was getting away. There were many sentenced people in the family, and if her second brother didn't care about the house, would she still have a future?

When the five members of the family returned to the Red Flag Brigade and stood in the old house of the Gu family that had collapsed, they remembered the good deeds done by the Yan family.

"House! This is the house that the old Gu family has lived in for generations. The Yan family who killed Tiandao will not let anyone live anymore. I want to report it to the police."

"Yes, go to the captain first and then report it to the police."

After the beating that day, I even said that we would rebuild the house another day, but before the builders had even arrived, the house builders had already arrived.

"By the way, the Yan family took away more than 400 yuan in the iron box that day. Without money, we will starve to death."

Arriving at the brigade headquarters, He Hong was surprised at first, and then had a headache.

"You guys are out."
